lines.append(f"  {addr['address2']}")

    lines.append(desc)

# Order IDs

lines.append(f"    {o_addr['country']}")
lines.append("")

lines.append("  Items Ordered:")
for itm in o.get('items', []):
    item_id = itm.get('item_id', 'N/A')
    name = itm.get('name', 'N/A')
    price = itm.get('price', 0)
    lines.append(f"    ▸ {name} (Item ID: {item_id}) — ${price:.2f}")
    options = itm.get('options', {})

        opts_str = ", ".join(f"{k}: {v}" for k, v in options.items())
        lines.append(f"      Options: {opts_str}")
lines.append("")

# Payment history

        lines.append(f"      Items:    {', '.join(items_shipped)}")
    lines.append("")

lines.append("=" * 62)
lines.append("  End of Records")
lines.append("=" * 62)
